prompt_summary: Straight-on symmetric child-sized skee-ball lane in one-point perspective, teal surface, yellow rails, purple hood, blank light target board, blank yellow marquee, blank dark score panel, no rings, holes, numbers, text, balls, or people, matching the claw-machine watercolor style.
post_processing: Built a protect barrier between the measured outer rail outlines from the hump to the bottom edge before corner flood-fill
Flood-filled only the connected cream paper margin from all four corners at 10% fuzz; no subject recolouring
Unioned the protected lane trapezoid into the alpha mask, then despill-safe alpha composited and converted to WebP at quality 88
calibration_method: Measured on the runtime pixel image and checked with art/review/skee-lane-overlay.png. Near/far lane edges converge at x=1200, the image centre. Board is above far.y; plate and panel are disjoint from board.
